_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) Financial Model
summary: The Financial Model provides the basis for finalizing unit price, cancellation ceilings, profit-sharing, and related pricing elements under the MYP Contract.
use_relationship:
The Financial Model will provide an adequate basis on which unit price, cancellation ceilings, profit-sharing, and other elements of Cancellation Ceiling and Investment Recovery and Proposal and Pricing can be finalized.
This DID contains the format and content preparation instruction for the data product result from the work task described in the contract Statement of Work (SOW).
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

children.title: The GAAP shall be delivered in electronic format (e.g. excel or PDF) to ensure compatibility with government systems
The Facilitation schedules shall be delivered in MS projects

Within twenty-five (25) business days of execution of this Agreement, the Contractor shall deliver to the Government a notional Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) financial model for the MYP Contract (the Financial Model) that covers 2025 through the term of the MYP Contract and includes comparable financials for the 2025 and 2026 MYP contracts.
children.content: The Financial Model will be refined and finalized as agreements with Suppliers are negotiated and finalized. A Contractor certified Financial Model shall be incorporated into the MYP Contract at award (or definitization, as applicable).

children.title: The GAAP shall include the following components:
An income statement through Program earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization (EBITDA)
A Facilitization Investment Schedule reflecting the timing and amount of specific Facilitization Investments that the Contractor intends to make
A statement of current assets and current liabilities, subject to the Government's right to audit the Financial Model following award of the MYP Contract.
The financial model will be subject to the Government's right to audit the Financial Model following award of the MYP Contract
The Financial Model must be complete, accurate, and certified by the Contractor.
The Financial Model must align with GAAP standards and include all required components as outlined above.
The facilitization investment schedule must reflect finalized agreements with suppliers and provide clear traceability of investments.
